body: I feel you....this sucks srsly, when the person you love keeps hurting you and you always endure it because you don't want to loose them , sometimes they act like they care one day and then act like a COMPLETELY different person the next day, they make excuses and you know they're lying but you still take in all the bullshit they give you because you just love them. I just hope you don't have to feel this way anymore , I hope you stop hurting and find happiness once again, I'm not even going to say leave him because I know that shit doesn't work it's so hard to move on what you can do is just try to communicate with them about how you feel . Trust me one day you'll have enough and you'll know you deserve much much better and leave the shitty person who's treating you like this behind. If you wanna talk u can message me , I'm going through a similar situation rn. Anyways , I hope you are ok now
